findings.description: A Content-Type parameter with no '=' (for example 'text/html; charset') is now stored as the boolean True. get_encoding_from_headers then calls .strip() on that value and raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response whose Content-Type is 'text/html; charset' with no value. _parse_content_type_header now sets params['charset'] = True instead of skipping the token. Mechanism: the 'charset' in params check passes and True.strip(...) raises AttributeError. Impact: accessing response.encoding or response.text raises an exception on such a malformed header, where the previous code silently fell back to ISO-8859-1.
